title: Table
pick: Pick a table or view in the Database sidebar.
running_pick: A statement is still running. Opening {name} stops it.
run_sql_tip: Run the SQL (the selection when there is one)
run_sql_over_read_tip: Stop reading the table and run the SQL (the selection when there is one)
sql_hint: ⌘↵ / Ctrl+Enter runs this SQL (the selection when there is one); the rows show under Data.
sql_over_read: The table is still being read. Run stops that read, then runs this SQL.
sql_busy: A statement is still running. Stop it first, then run again.
unsaved_one: 1 edited cell isn't written back yet
unsaved_other: {count} edited cells aren't written back yet
unsaved_writing_one: 1 edited cell is being written right now
unsaved_writing_other: {count} edited cells are being written right now
